title: BPO & Call Center Office Relocation in Addis: Workstations, Fiber & Weekend Moves
excerpt: Move BPO and call-center floors in Addis: desk labeling, headset custody, fiber cutover, weekend freight lifts, and office pricing from 45,000 ETB.
content:
BPO moves are timed IT projects

Business process outsourcing floors—dozens to hundreds of seats—cluster in Bole, Kazanchis, and Sengatera corridors. Moving agents is not like moving a home: you need asset tags, cable maps, and a fiber cutover window so Monday login works. Active Movers handles physical transport; your IT vendor owns boot, VLAN, and dialer tests.

Two weeks before

  • Number workstations on a floor plan; assign department colors.
  • Photograph under-desk cable runs and dual-monitor arms.
  • Confirm freight lift capacity for chair stacks and desk panels.
  • Book after-hours or full-weekend access at origin and destination buildings.
  • Name an internal move captain plus IT lead with mobile numbers for both sites.

Friday–Sunday playbook

Friday evening: disconnect labeled PCs and headsets into numbered bins; movers clear desks. Saturday: place desks to new floor plan; IT pulls fiber first; agents’ chairs follow. Sunday: buffer for failed ports, missing bins, and security re-inspection. Larger floors may need two weekends—split by row or department.

Chain of custody

Headsets, tokens, and paper with customer data move in sealed bins with sign-off sheets. E-waste stays separate from furniture. Confidential shredding should finish before movers load general office cartons.

Building and traffic

CBD towers share freight with other tenants—coordinate with management so BPO noise does not violate neighbor leases. Early-morning truck arrival beats Meskel-area congestion—freight timing · Kirkos overview.

Pricing

Office relocations start from 45,000 ETB for typical floors; seat count, packing, and phased weekends raise the quote. Compare office relocation service, Kazanchis playbook, and 2026 cost guide. Fixed scope beats open hourly at the gate—hourly vs fixed.

Monday login test

Before agents arrive, IT should spot-check ten random desks for network, headset, and dual-monitor arms. Movers remain on site for furniture tweaks until your move captain releases the crew—avoid cutting the weekend buffer.

Seat-count planning

Quote desk rows, not just square meters—120 seats with dual monitors need more truck hours than 120 empty desks. Share headcount and monitor count at survey so crew size matches cable labeling workload.
